description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Doc Samson.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it. 
Repeat.

uses.name: Doc Samson, Super Psychiatrist
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater
